headline: Brazil Lowers 2027 GDP Growth Target to 1.8% and Raises Inflation Outlook
summary: Brazil's Finance Ministry cut its 2027 economic growth forecast from 2.3% to 1.8% and increased its inflation estimate to 4.5%, pointing to high interest rates and tight credit conditions.
why: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy, and its official macroeconomic projections guide government fiscal policy and central bank interest rate settings.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Fiscal uncertainties and downgraded economic growth forecasts pressured Brazilian equity markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors reacted to reduced growth prospects and persistent inflation expectations, causing the Ibovespa benchmark index to fall below key technical levels.
